title: NoSupportedEvidence
description: The first-class, typed result of an answer request that no authorised evidence supports (master plan 12.5: AlixAI returns no_supported_evidence, and never converts model familiarity into an uncited document answer). It is an outcome of the answer API, not an error string and not an empty citation list: a client must handle it as one of the two members of an AnswerResult. It carries a typed reason and the retrieval notices and no text a model wrote. The same string is the common error code no_supported_evidence and the dialogue reason_code of a report_no_evidence act, so the result, the stream and the dialogue agree.

outcome.description: Always no_supported_evidence. Discriminates this result from a GroundedAnswer inside an AnswerResult.

reason.description: Why there is no supported answer. no_match: the authorised search found nothing relevant, including an empty evidence package. claims_unsupported: evidence was found but no claim of the candidate answer survived claim/source verification. evidence_unavailable: evidence was found but every supporting source was unavailable, removed or no longer authorised at the final recheck. egress_restricted: authorised evidence exists but the selected external provider may not receive it under the source's data-egress mode; produced only in external provider mode, never in Local mode, and never by silently sending the source. The reasons never say whether a source the principal may not see exists.

notices.description: Labels for a degraded or adjusted retrieval, for example reduced_semantic_recall, so a client can tell that a FTS-only search may have missed a paraphrase. Empty means none.
